code = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)))
    left_w = sep
    x0, x1 = sep + 1, w - 1
    bars = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == bg for c in range(left_w))]
    out = [row[:left_w] for row in grid]
    candidates = {}
    panels = list(zip(bars, bars[1:]))
    for top, bottom in panels:
        ys = range(top + 1, bottom)
        rh, rw = bottom - top - 1, x1 - x0
        colors = {grid[r][c] for r in ys for c in range(x0, x1) if grid[r][c] != 0}
        for color in colors:
            mask = tuple(tuple(grid[r][c] == color for c in range(x0, x1)) for r in ys)
            candidates[(rh, rw, mask)] = color
    for top, bottom in panels:
        ys = range(top + 1, bottom)
        mask = tuple(tuple(grid[r][c] != bg for c in range(1, left_w - 1)) for r in ys)
        key = (bottom - top - 1, left_w - 2, mask)
        color = candidates[key]
        for r, rowmask in zip(ys, mask):
            for j, active in enumerate(rowmask, 1):
                if active:
                    out[r][j] = color
    return out
'''
